method: Equivalent dependent wb_run drivers as tools/wasm-bench.ts, compiled before timing. Baseline and candidate A0 modules and clang -O3 modules are warmed four times, then timed in rotating order in one process; medians of nine samples with exact checksums on every call. Same dependent trips, seeds and trip counts as tools/wasm-bench.ts. Raw samples and module SHA-256 recorded. No other tests or builds run concurrently.
